detail_observations.text: Order of the True Blood [ edit ] Description Lennea says, "When we learned that the library of Leth Nurae had been robbed, we knew to suspect the drake riders ; those who call themselves the Order of the True Blood ." "They are a renegade group of high elves who have turned to drake riding instead of griffon riding." "If the drake riders wanted those ancient tomes, there must be powerful arcane secrets found within them." "Find the books and bring them back before the Order learns what it should not!" [ edit ] Objectives Go to the lair of the drake riders , and search piles of books for the stolen tomes. Bring the books back to Lennea Arrianth at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon . Stolen Ancient Tome (6) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: 600 Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 3s 50c A choice among: Eargem of Strength , Eargem of Resistance , Sheilding Eargem , Insightful Eargem Potion of Greater Strength , Potion of Greater Constitution , Potion of Greater Dexterity Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Recover_our_History " Category : Thestra 26-30 Quests

pages.article_html:
Recover our History

Level 36 · Adventuring · Thelaseen · Thestra

Go to the Lair of the Drake Riders and search piles of books for the stolen elven tomes.

Objectives

Stolen Elven tome (0/6)

Description

Lennea says, "When we learned that the library of Leth Nurae had been robbed, we knew to suspect the drake riders ; those who call themselves the Order of the True Blood ." "They are a renegade group of high elves who have turned to drake riding instead of griffon riding." "If the drake riders wanted those ancient tomes, there must be powerful arcane secrets found within them." "Find the books and bring them back before the Order learns what it should not!"

What they say

On offering it

Lennea
When we learned that the library of Leth Nurae had been robbed, we knew to suspect the drake riders ; those who call themselves the Order of the True Blood . They are a renegade group of high elves who have turned to drake riding instead of griffon riding. If the drake riders wanted those ancient tomes, there must be powerful arcane secrets found within them. Find the books and bring them back before the Order learns what it should not!

Recorded by quest description.

Lennea Arrianth
Lennea says, "When we learned that the library of Leth Nurae had been robbed, we knew to suspect the drake riders; those who call themselves the Order of the True Blood." "They are a renegade group of high elves who have turned to drake riding instead of griffon riding." "If the drake riders wanted those ancient tomes, there must be powerful arcane secrets found within them." "Find the books and bring them back before the Order learns what it should not!"

Recorded by vg-en.curse-gaming.com, Curse's Vanguard database before the rescale.

Notes

Turn in to Lennea Arrianth in Wardship of the Sleeping Moon.

Order of the True Blood [ edit ] Description Lennea says, "When we learned that the library of Leth Nurae had been robbed, we knew to suspect the drake riders ; those who call themselves the Order of the True Blood ." "They are a renegade group of high elves who have turned to drake riding instead of griffon riding." "If the drake riders wanted those ancient tomes, there must be powerful arcane secrets found within them." "Find the books and bring them back before the Order learns what it should not!" [ edit ] Objectives Go to the lair of the drake riders , and search piles of books for the stolen tomes. Bring the books back to Lennea Arrianth at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon .
